inlines.v: TRANS'MIGRANT, adjective [See Transmigrate.] Migrating; passing into another country or state for residence, or into another form or body. TRANS'MIGRANT, noun One who migrates or leaves his own country and passes into another for settlement. 1. One who passes into another state or body.
